title: OSF payload envelope (NATS, MQTT, Kafka) - v0.1.0
description: The two message shapes of standard/sync/uns-convention.json. signal = OT world, one subject per signal (factory.{site}.{machine}.telemetry|event.{attr}). entity = IT world, one subject per source row (business.{enterprise}.{sourceId}.{entity}.{eventType}.{id}); the attributes ride in data. Per profile, standard/payloads/json/** fixes attr and data, standard/payloads/avro/** is the Kafka value schema of the entity shape.

attr.description: Attribute name of the machine profile.

value.description: The value, typed by the attribute (x-signals in the profile payload).

quality.description: OPC UA StatusCode of the reading (Good, Uncertain, Bad...).

unit.description: UNECE Rec. 20 code of the attribute.

eventType.description: Runtime token of the subject (uns-convention runtimeTokens).

id.description: The row key = the kgIdProperty value of the profile.

data.description: The attributes of the profile, typed per profile.
